title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Remote, Latam, Full Time, Individual Contributor, +4 years of experience

Who We Are

At Yuno , we are building the payment infrastructure that allows all companies to participate in the global market. Founded by seasoned experts from the payments and tech industries, our technology provides access to leading payment capabilities, enabling companies to engage customers confidently and maintain global operations through seamless integrations.

We empower high-performing teams at brands like InDrive, McDonald's, Rappi, and Viva Aerobus to integrate over 1,000 payment methods via a single API. By leveraging advanced AI and the latest technologies, we orchestrate smart routing and fraud prevention across 80+ countries.

About The Role

We are orchestrating the best high-performing team!

As a Customer Solutions Engineer, you are the technical owner of a merchant's journey with Yuno from the first discovery call to the first transaction in production. You sit on both sides of the deal: you design the solution that wins it, and you build the integration that makes it real. Demos, technical discovery, architecture proposals, RFPs and security reviews on one side; integration planning, API guidance, testing, and go-live on the other.

You will work with merchants processing millions of transactions across LATAM, each with a different stack, a different set of PSPs, and a different definition of "done". You will map their payment flows, find where Yuno fits, and translate that into something an engineering team can actually ship. Quality is the standard here, not the goal: every payment, every user, every time. An integration that goes live with unresolved edge cases is not a finished integration.

No two merchants integrate the same way, and priorities shift as deals move. You will need to adapt fast, pick up new payment methods and markets as they come, and stay effective when the plan changes mid-cycle. You will also be the connection point between Sales, Product, Engineering, and the merchant's own developers, making sure nothing gets lost between what was promised and what was built.

If you like being the person in the room who can answer the hard technical question and then go implement the answer, we want to talk to you.

Your Contribution Will Be

• Lead technical discovery with prospects to understand their payment stack, requirements, and constraints.

• Run product demos and deliver technical presentations to engineering and product audiences.

• Design payment orchestration solutions and integration architectures tailored to each merchant.

• Respond to RFPs, security questionnaires, and technical due diligence with Sales.

• Own the end-to-end implementation, from kickoff and integration plan to testing and go-live.

• Guide merchant developers through Yuno 's APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and payment method configurations.

• Troubleshoot integration issues across payment flows, API logs, and third-party providers.

• Build reusable demo environments, integration guides, and technical documentation that shorten future cycles.

• Hand off live merchants to Technical Account Management with complete context and documentation.

• Feed recurring merchant requirements and integration friction back to Product and Engineering.

Skills You Need

Minimum Qualifications

• Fluent English, both written and spoken, is required. Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.

• +4 years of experience in solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical implementation, or integration roles.

• Hands-on technical skills: REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, HTTP debugging, and at least one programming language for building demos and sample integrations.

• Payments knowledge: gateways, PSPs, acquirers, card networks, 3DS, tokenization, refunds, chargebacks, and alternative payment methods.

• Experience running technical conversations with both engineering teams and commercial stakeholders.

• Proven track record delivering integration projects with external develo

title: Scientist R&D – Immunohistochemistry (IHC) & Histology
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Natera is seeking a highly motivated Scientist, R&D - Immunohistochemistry (IHC) & Histology to join the Oncology Product Development team. This role will focus on the development, optimization, verification, and validation of IHC and tissue-based workflows supporting oncology products and clinical assay development.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in IHC assay development and optimization, supported by a solid foundation in histology and FFPE tissue workflows. Experience with automated IHC/ISH staining platforms, particularly the Roche BenchMark ULTRA IHC/ISH System, is highly desirable. Experience with NGS and molecular biology workflows is an additional plus.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Design and execute development, optimization, verification, and validation studies for IHC, histology, and tissue-based workflows.

• Develop and optimize IHC assays, including antibody selection and titration, antigen retrieval, staining conditions, controls, and assay performance assessment.

• Evaluate and optimize histology and pre-analytical variables, including tissue fixation, FFPE processing, embedding, sectioning, H&E staining, and slide preparation.

• Develop and troubleshoot workflows on automated IHC/ISH staining platforms and investigate staining artifacts, reagent performance, tissue quality, and assay variability.

• Plan and execute moderate- to high-complexity experiments; analyze and interpret results using tools such as Excel, JMP, and image-analysis approaches.

• Collaborate with Pathology, Clinical Laboratory Operations, Quality, Automation, and other cross-functional teams to transfer R&D methods into robust clinical laboratory workflows.

• Author study protocols, development/validation reports, SOPs, and transfer documentation, and provide technical guidance and training during implementation.

• Communicate project progress, experimental findings, risks, and recommendations to project teams and stakeholders.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

Ph.D. in Pathology, Cancer Biology, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related field with a minimum of 2 years of relevant industry experience; or a Master's degree with a minimum of 5 years of relevant industry experience; or a Bachelor's degree with a 6-8+ years of relevant industry experience.

 

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

• Strong hands-on expertise in IHC assay development, optimization, and troubleshooting, with solid knowledge of histology and FFPE tissue workflows.

• Experience with antibody characterization/titration, antigen retrieval, staining optimization, controls, tissue morphology, and assay performance evaluation.

• Experience with automated IHC/ISH platforms is highly preferred; hands-on experience with the Roche BenchMark ULTRA IHC/ISH System is a strong plus.

• Experience with H&E staining, microtomy/tissue sectioning, microscopy, digital pathology, or image analysis is desirable.

• NGS and molecular biology experience is a plus, particularly with FFPE nucleic acid extraction, PCR/qPCR, NGS library preparation, or hybrid capture workflows.

• Experience with assay development and validation in a regulated clinical laboratory, molecular diagnostics, or LDT environment is preferred.

• Ability to independently design and execute experiments, interpret data, troubleshoot technical challenges, and determine appropriate next steps.

• Strong technical writing, communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced R&D environment.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

You will partner closely with the marketing leader who owns clinical community engagement (KOLs, conferences, and speaker programs), and with Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, and corporate Commercial Operations, to ensure a single, integrated go-to-market plan.

 

The ideal candidate pairs analytical rigor with a roll-up-your-sleeves mindset, and is equally comfortable in a messaging workshop, a field ride-along, and a funnel dashboard. As the business scales, this role is expected to grow into a team.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Product Marketing & Messaging

• Positioning & Messaging: Own product positioning and the core messaging framework for Zenith, translating complex genomic science into clear value propositions for clinicians, genetic counselors, and health systems.

• Sales Interface: Serve as the primary day-to-day marketing partner to Sales leadership; run regular field feedback loops and translate what reps and customers are telling us into messaging, tools, and priorities.

• Market Access Pull-Through: Partner with Market Access and Reimbursement to convert coverage and payer developments into field-ready tools and messaging.

 

Commercial Insights & Targeting

• Sales Operations Liaison: Represent the Rare Disease BU's needs to corporate Commercial Operations (CRM, reporting, forecasting, and ordering workflow) and ensure the field has clean data and low-friction processes.

 

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Integrated Planning: Partner with the clinical community marketing lead (KOL, conferences, speaker programs) so that field events, thought-leader engagement, and product messaging operate as one plan.

• Matrix Collaboration: Serve as the commercial connective tissue across Sales

title: Brand Designer
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Brand Designer to help shape how SpaceXAI shows up in the world. This role is built for someone who has built brand systems in fast-moving environments, cares deeply about craft, and brings an AI-first mindset to how creative work gets made. You’ll join the Brand Studio, the team behind the brand across the entire SpaceXAI ecosystem (from Grok and Grok Bot to X), and help shape both the brand system itself and how it comes to life in our campaigns.

This is a hands-on role. Much of the foundation is still being built, so you’ll spend real time designing and making things yourself. It also comes with significant ownership: you’ll lead projects from first concept through final execution, and your work will help set the bar for how the brand evolves.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Brand system: Evolve and extend the visual identity (logo, typography, color, layout, imagery, and graphic language) and document it so other teams can apply it correctly.

- Workflows & toolkits: Turn recurring design work into repeatable, AI-assisted workflows: templates, tools, and generators that let marketing, product, and other teams produce on-brand work without you in the room.

- Campaigns: Concept and design campaigns end to end, from first idea through final production, across key visuals, launch assets, web, social, paid, out-of-home, and print.

- Creative direction: Direct agencies and freelancers with clear briefs and candid feedback so the output meets the bar you’d set yourself.

- Collaboration: Partner with marketing, product, engineering, and leadership; bring a brand point of view to new surfaces as they appear, and present your thinking clearly to senior stakeholders.

- Range at speed: Move between projects quickly while holding a consistently high bar, and keep improving the process, not just the output.

WHAT YOU BRING

- 6+ years of brand design experience, in-house or at an agency or studio.

- Fluency in AI coding tools, especially Cursor. You can build your own tools, scripts, prototypes, and simple web pages instead of waiting on engineering.

- A portfolio that shows both brand system work and shipped campaigns. Bonus if it includes tools or workflows you built.

- Sharp typography, layout, and art direction instincts.

- A systems mindset: you naturally turn one-off tasks into reusable processes and think about how creative work scales.

- Conviction in your design decisions and the ability to explain why they matter, to designers, marketers, and leadership alike.

- Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud.

- Self-directed, fast, and energized by variety and ambiguity.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience building or relaunching a brand identity at a fast-growing tech company.

- Motion sensibility, enough to design with motion in mind and direct motion designers.

- Experience leading agencies on large, multi-channel campaigns.

title: Koordinátor/ka směny / Nový sklad Rohlíku v Opatovicích
description:
Opatovice nad Labem | mezi Hradcem Králové a Pardubicemi | krátký/dlouhý týden | 12hodinové směny

🚀 V Opatovicích nad Labem otevíráme úplně nový sklad Rohlíku. Hledáme lidi, kteří nám pomohou rozjet jeho provoz od samého začátku.

Tohle není práce ve skladu, kde už deset let všechno běží podle stejných pravidel. Tým se teprve tvoří, nový provoz startuje a procesy budeme společně ladit v praxi.

Hledáme proto někoho, kdo se umí rozhlédnout kolem sebe, rychle vyhodnotit situaci a zorganizovat lidi tak, aby směna šlapala.

Nemusíš být ostřílený manažer ani mít deset let zkušeností z logistiky. Důležité je, že umíš pracovat s lidmi, neztratíš se v rychlém provozu a dokážeš převzít odpovědnost.

📦 Co tě u nás čeká?

Během směny budeš přímo v centru skladového provozu. Budeš sledovat, co se právě děje, kde je potřeba přidat ruce, změnit priority nebo rychle vyřešit vzniklou situaci.

Budeš:

- koordinovat práci lidí během směny a rozdělovat je podle aktuální potřeby,

- hlídat plynulý chod jednotlivých částí skladu,

- reagovat na změny a řešit operativní situace,

- spolupracovat s příjmem, expedicí a dalšími částmi provozu,

- sledovat provozní čísla a podle nich rozhodovat, co je potřeba změnit,

- hledat cesty, jak práci v novém skladu dělat jednodušeji a efektivněji.

Postupně poznáš celý proces - od příjezdu zboží až po chvíli, kdy hotový nákup přebírá kurýr a vyráží k zákazníkovi.

👀 Koho hledáme?

Hlavně člověka, který si umí poradit v provozu a s lidmi.

Bude se ti u nás dařit, pokud:

- dokážeš rychle reagovat a rozhodnout se,

- umíš si zachovat přehled, i když se děje několik věcí najednou,

- dovedeš lidi zorganizovat a jasně říct, co je potřeba,

- jsi férový/á, ale zároveň se nebojíš převzít odpovědnost,

- zvládneš pracovat s čísly a převést je do konkrétního rozhodnutí,

- místo věty „takhle se to vždycky dělalo“ raději přemýšlíš, jak by to šlo udělat lépe.

Zkušenost ze skladu nebo logistiky je výhodou, ale není podmínkou. Zajímavá pro nás může být i zkušenost z výroby, retailu, gastronomie nebo jiného rychlého provozu, kde jsi koordinoval/a lidi a musel/a operativně řešit, co přinesl den.

⏰ Jak se pracuje?

Pracujeme v režimu krátký/dlouhý týden na 12hodinové směny.

A důležitá věc: tohle není vedoucí pozice od počítače. Většinu směny strávíš přímo v provozu mezi lidmi. Potřebujeme, abys věděl/a, co se ve skladu skutečně děje.

🥐 Co od nás dostaneš?

Kromě možnosti být u otevření úplně nového skladu Rohlíku nabízíme:

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma a 10% cashback v kreditech na další nákupy,

- možnost placeného volna pro odpočinek a regeneraci,

- dotované obědy,

- kávu, čerstvé ovoce a další občerstvení na pracovišti zdarma,

- 86 Kč na ošatné za každou odpracovanou směnu,

- odměny za pochvaly od kolegů, které můžeš proměnit například za vouchery do Alzy nebo Notina,

- příspěvek na Multisport kartu,

- firemní akce a společné oslavy úspěchů.

💚 Nový sklad. Nový tým. A příležitost být u toho od začátku.

Nový sklad se otevírá jen jednou.

V Opatovicích budeš nastupovat ve chvíli, kdy se tým teprve skládá a celý provoz dostává svoji podobu. Nebudeš tedy jen přebírat něco, co nastavil někdo před tebou - můžeš být mezi lidmi, kteří ovlivní, jak bude sklad fungovat další roky.

A než nový sklad naplno spustíme, ukážeme ti také naše fungující robotické sklady v Praze, abys viděl/a celý provoz Rohlíku v praxi.

Zní ti to zajímavě? Ozvi se.

Nemusíš nám psát dlouhý motivační dopis. Pošli nám svůj profil nebo CV a pojďme si krátce zavolat. Třeba právě s tebou nový sklad v Opatovicích rozjedeme.

title: Staff Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
description:
ABOUT US

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents.

Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services.

All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down.

The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. The team is small enough that engineers own problems end to end, from design through on-call.

ABOUT YOU

You're a staff-level engineer who wants to own systems, not tickets. You've built high-traffic, low-latency Python services and carried the pager for them. You think in trade-offs: latency versus cost, flexibility versus a public API that customers can't afford to see break, the fix that ships this week versus the architecture that has to last two years. You can lead work that spans several engineers and several quarters, you enjoy mentoring others, and you're fine when a problem shows up half-defined. You don't mind being the one who reads the spec for some unfamiliar protocol, works out how it fits, and designs an integration that holds up at scale. You change your mind when someone has a better argument, you make the people around you better, and you still care about your code long after it merges.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Own the technical direction of one or more of our services - architecture, performance, and reliability.

- Lead design of new systems and public APIs, and the evolution of existing ones as traffic and feature scope grow.

- Raise the engineering bar through design and code review, and mentor mid and senior engineers into owning bigger scopes.

- Partner with product, other engineering teams, and solutions/support to shape what we build and to represent search constraints and trade-offs honestly.

- Take part in on-call for the systems you own, and lead incident response and follow-through when things break.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

TECHNICAL

- Substantial experience building and operating high-traffic, low-latency backend services in production.

- Extensive Python knowledge (our primary language).

- Experience with observability and performance work in live systems.

- Experience designing and evolving public APIs that external customers depend on.

- Experience designing & implementing scalable service-oriented architectures.

BEYOND THE CODE

- Track record of leading projects that span multiple engineers and quarters.

- Influence without authority, and willingness to change your position wh

title: Dispatcher
description:
About the Role
We are looking for an organised, proactive, and detail-oriented Dispatcher to coordinate non-emergency medical transportation (NEMT) services for patients and members in the United States.
In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating transportation requests, assigning trips to drivers, monitoring journeys in real time, and ensuring that members arrive at their destinations safely and on time. You will act as the central point of communication between drivers, healthcare facilities, scheduling teams, and other stakeholders to keep daily transportation operations running smoothly.
The ideal candidate has experience in dispatch, logistics, or transportation coordination and can think on their feet when schedules change or unexpected issues arise. You should be comfortable working across multiple systems, managing competing priorities, and communicating clearly and professionally in a fast-paced environment.
Requirements
Key Responsibilities
Trip Intake & Scheduling

• Receive and review transportation requests through systems such as Zoho Desk and MOVI.

• Verify trip details, including pickup and drop-off locations, appointment times, service requirements, and any special accommodations.

• Confirm trip readiness, eligibility, and required authorisations in line with company procedures.

• Identify missing information or scheduling conflicts before trips are assigned.

Driver Coordination

• Assign trips to drivers based on availability, location, vehicle suitability, and service requirements.

• Communicate trip details, special instructions, and schedule changes clearly to drivers.

• Monitor driver availability and trip progress throughout the day.

• Coordinate adjustments when drivers become unavailable or transportation needs change.

Real-Time Dispatch Management

• Monitor active trips and track on-time performance.

• Respond promptly to delays, cancellations, driver no-shows, vehicle breakdowns, and missed pickups.

• Provide routing guidance and support to drivers when needed.

• Communicate transportation updates and estimated arrival times (ETAs) to healthcare facilities, medical offices, staff, and family members.

• Coordinate return trips, facility wait times, and same-day transportation changes.

• Resolve service concerns professionally while prioritising member safety and continuity of service.

Documentation & System Updates

• Update trip statuses accurately in dispatch and transportation management systems.

• Record delays, cancellations, incidents, and service-related issues.

• Maintain complete trip notes and required compliance documentation.

• Ensure records are accurate, up to date, and aligned with company procedures.

Problem-Solving & Operational Support

• Identify and resolve scheduling conflicts, coverage gaps, and potential service disruptions.

• Escalate urgent or complex issues to the appropriate team members or management.

• Collaborate with schedulers, drivers, and operational teams to maintain efficient service delivery.

• Assist with urgent or additional transportation requests when required.

Requirements

• Previous experience in dispatch, transportation coordination, logistics, or fleet operations is required .

• Strong organisational and time-management skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple trips, requests, and priorities simultaneously.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain calm under pressure.

• Comfortable working with scheduling software, transportation management systems, and digital communication tools.

• Strong attention to detail when reviewing trip information and maintaining records.

• Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

• Willingness to work US business hours consistently.

Preferred Experience

• Experience with non-emergency medical transportation (NEMT) operations.

• Familiarity with healthcare scheduling and patient transportation coord

• Comfortable working in a fully remote, member-driven organization.

• Commitment: Ability to dedicate approximately one working day (6-8 hours) per week to have a tangible impact.

• Relevant certifications are a plus but not required (e.g., CISSP, CISM, Security+, CCSP, GIAC).

• Exposure to AI/ML security considerations helpful, not required.

description:

Hunter is looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our fully remote team. This role is about using email, social, channel, and paid to help users reach their a-ha moment in the product, increase usage, and generate revenue.
You’ll be the go-to person for all things lifecycle, owning the strategy and execution of this critical area.
You’ll report to the Head of Marketing, and work alongside a cross-departmental team: Ana (Account Manager), Antonio, Chris (Design), Gio (Head of Customer Success), Istvan (Design), Jeanro, Matt (CEO), Rui (Product Manager), and Ziemek.
Requirements
At Hunter , Marketing is a core part of how we generate brand affinity and revenue.
Hunter sits in a highly-competitive category with increasing noise, but thanks to its lineage as a first mover in 2015, it is an established, trusted brand.
In this role, you'll cut through that noise, joining a team of enthusiastic, highly-skilled marketers who take pride in their role as a caretaker of the brand. The touch points that we have with our users, as a trusted voice in a sea-of-sameness, are critical to growing the loyalty that millions of users have with Hunter .
Your goal is to own the entire lifecycle of our users so that more eyeballs see Hunter , more users find, verify, and send emails using the platform, API, and MCP server, and our brand continues to be the trusted voice in this category.
How marketing works at Hunter

Hunter 's marketing has grown from SEO foundations. Over the last two years, more activity in research, content, email marketing, paid media, and affiliates have contributed to incredible growth.
Your task is to work on the onboarding and nurture engine that engages our users to promote our content, convert free users to paid plans, and increase the lifetime value of our users.
In this role, you need deep knowledge of this category, user empathy, and the stakeholder & project management skills to work with the Head of Marketing, Head of Customer Success, Product Manager, and our marketing team to deliver growth measured in free>paid conversion rate, lifetime value, and retention.
You'll walk into an established onboarding and nurture engine, dozens of campaigns, and co-marketing opportunities, and immediately hit the ground running, firstly by reviewing and creating rapid improvements to onboarding and nurturing, before turning your attention to planning and executing critical Q1 campaigns.
Ownership areas include:

• Email marketing (onboarding, nurturing, retention, win-back, newsletters, and promotional)

• Cold email marketing

• Co-marketing with partners

• Affiliate marketing campaigns

• Social media

• Written and video content creation (inc. blogs and webinars)

• Reporting and insights

What you’ll do:

•
Own the user journey: You'll work cross-department to own the full user journey - from search and account creation, through to converting to a paid plan, increasing usage, and limiting churn - leveraging the full channel mix to engage, educate, and nurture users.

•
Increase free-to-paid conversions: Your core measurement is the ability to convert free user to a paid plan.

•
Establish and improve the nurture engine : You'll build a nurture engine that leverages user-behavior and persona signals to deliver personalized communications that builds brand affinity.

•
Promote content, research, and playbooks : You'll distribute highly-valuable content to help our users be more effective in their outreach, promoting webinars, guides, playbooks, the Outfoxed podcast, and monthly research.

•
Sales enablement : You'll identify users who might need help getting started, maximizing their plan, or with multiple users from their account and proactively engage them to support sales pipeline generation.

title: Humanitarian Immigration Attorney - T Visa, U Visa & VAWA
description:
Help survivors of trafficking, violence and crime find safety and legal status.
Mangone Law Firm is expanding its humanitarian relief team and is hiring attorneys who already know T visa, U visa and VAWA work. You will handle your own caseload, appear before USCIS and immigration courts, and work with a dedicated paralegal and legal support team.
About Us
Mangone Law Firm, LLC is a New Jersey-based immigration law firm serving clients nationwide since 2012. We were named to the 2025 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies. • Lead case strategy and conduct initial case reviews and consultations.
